description: Stage 1 arm B0: the full-data backbone comparison. The large backbone hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext-large trained on all 749 training chapters' weak S3 labels (weak build 20261003-weak_v2, setting S3, the same label file and training chapters as the existing base runs runs/20261003-tag-S3-s{1,2,3}-dev31), so B0 - S3 is the effect of swapping the backbone (base -> large, the whole swap, not the parameter count alone) on the data the project already has. To keep the comparison clean the schedule is S3's own: max_epochs 6, dev every half epoch, patience 3, batch 16 (235 steps per epoch, 1410 planned; S3's three seeds stopped by patience after about 3 epochs); only lr changes to 2e-5 (the usual large-model rate) and batch 16 is reached as 2 micro-batches of 8 (grad_accumulation 2; token-weighted, so the loss, gradient and schedule equal a whole batch's; the orchestrator may set it to 1 after measuring memory). The sufficiency record in metrics.json says whether this schedule was enough for large; if not, the run is repeated with more epochs and both are reported. Expected cost on the RTX 5080: about 5-10 minutes per seed (base took 1-2 minutes). Three seeds. Nothing tuned on dev2 or the test.

arms.S3: B0 (weak S3 labels, 749 chapters, large; compare with runs/20261003-tag-S3-s*-dev31)

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 1,306,484,351 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 1.31 GB); no safetensors in the repo

grad_accumulation_note: micro-batch 8; set to 1 if the orchestrator's memory test shows a batch of 16 fits (same loss and schedule either way)
planned_steps_note: 749 chapters = 3751 windows / 16 = 235 steps per epoch x 6 = 1410 planned, S3's schedule
